# Vybe Technologies

> Vybe Technologies is a Bengaluru software company. Its products include a cloud ERP for schools and colleges and a 100% cashless cafeteria management system, alongside custom software development, cybersecurity and cloud infrastructure for businesses in any sector.

Based in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. Sales: sales@vybe.net.in / +91-99641-77677.

## Products

- [Vybe ERP](https://vybe.net.in/erp/): Cloud ERP for school and college administration.
- [Vybe CMS](https://vybe.net.in/cms/): 100% cashless cafeteria ordering and payouts.
- [Smart Classrooms](https://vybe.net.in/smart-classroom/): Logic interactive flat panels, online class rigs and writing boards.
- [Workspace & Email](https://vybe.net.in/workspace/): Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Zoho Mail and student email.
- [IT & Cyber](https://vybe.net.in/it-solutions/): Custom software, security and managed IT.
- [Printing](https://vybe.net.in/printing/): Everything from business cards to banners, standees and RFID cards.
- [Business Registrations](https://vybe.net.in/registrations/): GST, Udyam (MSME), FSSAI and Startup India recognition, from ₹199, plus ISO, NSDC consulting and digital signatures.
- [Compliance Audits](https://vybe.net.in/audits/): Hygiene, fire, child safety, SDG, POSH and data protection audits for kitchens, campuses and offices. Report, certificate and badge.
- [Manufacturing & Supply](https://vybe.net.in/manufacturing/): RFID cards from ₹16.50 and NFC from ₹50, made and encoded to your system, IoT asset and energy monitoring, plus Dell, HP, Lenovo, Asus and Apple hardware.
